data.narrative:
Harbinger is a Series C transportation-technology company that has raised $358M to date. The relevant peer universe consists of 8 private companies in transportation, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Slate Auto, and ZeroAvia; no public transportation comps were identified.

Of the applicable valuation methods, Stage-Progression analysis is suitable given Harbinger's established Series C status and substantial capital deployment. Using total raised ($358M) as a proxy base and applying a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier for progression to the next institutional funding stage yields an implied valuation of $170M. Peer-Median methodology was not applicable, as the narrow peer set lacked sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comps (fewer than 3 datapoints met filtering criteria); broadening to all-sector peers would introduce undue noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M (low) to $195M (high), with a median point of $170M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method and underscores the primary uncertainty: lack of sufficiently granular comparable data within transportation at the Series C stage. Additional precision would require either a larger peer dataset at equivalent maturity or acquisition of stage-to-stage progression metrics specific to frontier transportation ventures.
